dataset.name: OPSD Wind
dataset.selection: ten VS dates stratified by forecast-context quantiles; all 90 TEST dates frozen

model.anchor_definition: first 24 raw forecast-context columns, transformed with the LS-fitted target scaler
model.conditioning_order: 33 LS-fitted standardized context columns followed by 24 standardized forecast-anchor columns
model.negative_phase_backend: sa (directly recorded in frozen checkpoint JSON)

test.date_policy: all frozen TEST dates in the historical fixed-window split
test.matrix_status: logical h,J frozen; hardware gain unresolved until real VS calibration

budget.sampling_credits_conversion: pending confirmation after first real task
budget.backup_condition: no automatic reserve use; any exception requires separate manual confirmation

gain_selection.freeze_rule: freeze exactly one gain after verified real VS responses; rebuild TEST Q from original h,J

quality_gate.identity_gate: all 30 gain-condition responses must pass strict task, matrix, response-hash, metadata, and 100-read validation
quality_gate.aggregation: recompute metrics from validated response files and aggregate by gain across the same 10 VS conditions; ignore supplied quality status fields
quality_gate.reference_audit: independent local float logical SA repeats; suggested thresholds are empirical null quantiles only
quality_gate.default_action: lock TEST until a pre-defined quality policy is frozen

quality_rule.error_metrics: gain mean must be <= approved threshold for energy_wasserstein, effective_beta_error, edge_moment_mae, and magnetization_mae
quality_rule.diversity_metric: gain mean unique_state_fraction must be >= approved minimum
quality_rule.selection: select only among quality-pass gains; all fail or any identity/format failure locks TEST

stop_rules: missing, duplicate, extra, or hash-mismatched response locks TEST
all gains failing quality locks TEST
thresholds without independent-reference evidence remain unapproved
